zoho.title: Zoho templates
zoho.description: Manage templates in the separate Zoho Email API library. Office templates remain local and versioned independently.
zoho.setupFailed: Could not check Zoho Email API setup
zoho.setupRetry: Retry the setup check to continue.
zoho.workspaceMismatchTitle: Zoho is not bound to this workspace
zoho.workspaceMismatchDescription: The authenticated Office workspace does not match the workspace bound to Zoho Email API. Template access stays disabled until server configuration is corrected.
zoho.separateProductTitle: Zoho Email API is not configured
zoho.separateProductDescription: Cloud templates require the separate prepaid Zoho Email API product configured for this Office workspace through the server environment below. Zoho Campaigns OAuth does not provide template library access.
zoho.oauthSeparation: The API key stays on the Office server. It is never entered in this browser.
zoho.editorHint: Saving here writes directly to the separate Zoho Email API library. Office keeps its own immutable template versions.
zoho.rawSourceHint: HTML source remains available in code mode. Unsupported native markup stays intact until you explicitly convert before visual editing.
zoho.nativeEditTitle: This native template is kept in source mode to preserve its layout
zoho.nativeEditDescription: Compose would remove unsupported markup from this source. Edit the raw HTML and preview it below, or explicitly convert to the Office-compatible subset before using Compose. Saving a conversion updates Zoho only after you submit it.
zoho.detailFailed: Could not load this Zoho template.
zoho.saveFailed: Could not save this Zoho template.
zoho.deleteFailed: Could not delete this Zoho template.
zoho.staleTemplate: This Zoho template changed after you opened it. The latest version is loading; review it before making another change.
zoho.selectTemplate: Choose a cloud template to preview its content.
zoho.nativeContentTitle: This template uses native HTML the Office editor cannot represent fully
zoho.nativeContentWarning: Office import uses the compatible-copy workflow and may remove markup. This preview keeps the native layout in an isolated frame; the original Zoho source stays intact.
zoho.nativePreviewNetworkNotice: External images and other network resources are blocked in this isolated preview. Inline styles, tables, and layout are preserved.
zoho.importDescription: Review the copy rules and decide what each Zoho merge field should become before opening the Office version editor.
zoho.compatibilityTitle: Unsupported HTML will be removed from the Office copy
zoho.compatibilityWarning: Office supports basic email formatting. Images, styles, scripts, and unsupported attributes will be excluded from the new Office version; this does not change the original Zoho template.
zoho.originalPreserved: The native Zoho template and its source will remain unchanged.
zoho.mergeFieldsHint: Choose an Office variable or explicitly remove every field. Nothing is mapped automatically.
zoho.invalidOfficeVariable: Use a variable name with letters, digits, underscores, and dots; it must start with a letter or underscore.
zoho.unknownTitle: Zoho may have completed this change
zoho.unknownOutcome: The provider outcome is unknown. The cloud library is being refreshed. Compare the remote template before trying again; Office will not repeat this operation automatically.
zoho.acknowledgeReconciliation: I confirmed Zoho did not apply this change; start a new attempt
zoho.deleteWarning: “{name}” will be deleted from Zoho and cannot be undone in Zoho. This does not affect Office versions.
